title: Distances are stored in miles
context: All route code (src/route/*.js) stores distances in miles, with no unit written in saved routes.

options.name: Miles, implicit
options.summary: What the code does now: every distance is in miles, never stated.
pros: Matches the trail guides the first users read

options.name: Kilometres inside, miles on screen if asked
options.summary: Store kilometres everywhere and convert only for display.
pros: Matches GPX files and most map data
cons: Every distance in the code and in saved routes changes

recommendation: Route files and map data are metric, so miles force a conversion at every edge of the app.
strain: Decision 0004 saves routes as GPX, which is metric, so every save and load now converts miles back and forth.
